newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen stuck in range ahead of auction.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen stuck in range ahead of auction.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: injection of 300 bln yen

*Japanese government bond futures expected to be trapped in narrow range ahead of 10-year JGB auction, results of which are due at 2.30 p.m. (0530 GMT). *New 10-year JGB coupon expected to be set at 2.3 or 2.4 percent, down from 2.5 percent in previous offering.
